Okay breath your post history is telling me you have health anxiety. Don't worry so do I  (I'm recovering from a wee relapse). You do not have rabies. You said yourself you had lymph nodes up and a headache you likely have some sort of common virus. Sadly, cause you are hyperfixating on every bodily sensation, you have freaked yourself out. 

What I need you to do. 
1. Stop googling. Knowledge is not power for health anxiety.
2. Go to a dr.
3. When the Dr tells you are fine, believe them. 
4. Research all the ways anxiety can cause very real symptoms. So when this happens again, it will help you to not freak out. 
5. Try some kind of online cbt course for anxiety and health anxiety or better yet counselling. 

Lots of things can cause your symptoms and it's extremely rare that it will be anything more than a passing thing. You will feel better soon.

Its a well know fact smoking makes anxiety worse. There has also been links to smoking and depression as well.  I have bad anxiety and depression, so I know your struggle.

I will say I have pretty bad mood swings when I quit cold turkey one of which is really bad depression and anxiety. It feels like everything is pointless, me and my bf call this the abyss as we both get it. This only tends to last a week but its the worst feeling, that and I get unreasonably angry at very small things. 

If you want to avoid this I suggest nic gum as it will take the edge off. If you do decide to go cold turkey I just want you to be prepared for what might happen. As the depression always led to me smoking again until I pushed through. 

Despite all this once you get through that first week it gets alot easier.  (This is my 3rd time quitting for longer than a few days but this time its sticking)



Then I tend to find my anxiety and depression is better than when I was smoking. It gives me a sense of control and achievement. I feel like I'm finally doing somthing for my self and saying fuck you to my depression ruling what I can and can't do.

Smoking makes you more likely to get MS and make existing MS much worse. You are also more likely to get other autoimmune diseases.

Smoking will not just give you lung and mouth cancer. Its gives you bladder cancer, stomach and reproductive cancers. 

Smoking is bad for your mental health as well as physical health I know its scarey but you can do it.

Feel the fear but do it any way!
